notes.title: Game development progress #12
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/f702123bc3c2435dd12899112aeb42496f4350b3.png

Hello everyone,

Thank you all for your continued support and patience. We’d like to share our current development progress with you.

Train System

New Vehicle Introduced
In this update, we’ve added a new motorcycle as a vehicle. Players can freely ride, carry passengers, and travel quickly through the open world to explore various locations.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/23f2c3e484089138b2e56cb1826f6b0a06b40c45.png

Different Platforms, Different Encounters
Each platform in the open world now randomly generates different NPCs. Players can witness them getting on and off the train in real time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/866603d0b8c3bbd894bd71a9201777c89b23df3a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/23c772c7a921c1bdd555ae0acc79c2d302f9d64f.png

Meet New Girls
After boarding the train, players can actively start conversations and build relationships with different NPCs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/3e6e15589ac923f73ddf0eed045d8b3feff071fb.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/b441c2833f5a5ee6d2b9b84b48a2e7359a9350c0.png

Train Interactions – Exciting and Tense
Players are free to interact on the train—but be careful! In public spaces, you’ll need to watch out for others’ attention!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/d79537c15b960970501ea33d1ec287b8c97b9a6a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/59cfe003ef3b1c1496e465a6143aa166f8be14d9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/3ad5628a6341c93fb918f9dbcfceccafb87190bf.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/6cc0f980bc5af2f89cf1cbfe4179d94131499f98.png

Two-Person Interactions

Significantly Increased Number of Poses
Previously, each interaction only had a single pose with slow, medium, and fast speed variations.  
This time, we’ve created 3 different pose animations for each speed level.  
The total number of interaction poses has more than tripled, making the experience much richer and more natural!

Watcher System
To enhance tension and realism during interactions, we’ve added a variety of watcher roles!  
While interacting, players may encounter train conductors, unknown tourists, or vineyard staff...  
You’ll need to find ways to deal with them if you want the interaction to go smoothly!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/aef95c70770bcdb2917d2d1e8a7d9b65d08fa489.png

Improved Clothing Details
We’ve custom-designed undressing behavior for each outfit during interactions!  
This includes different accessories, stockings, and even physical characteristics.  
All of these improvements were made based on valuable feedback from our players!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/3f89553155d3f0ea3109a7105a2bfde716c33d2e.png

Over this period, we know that many players may have felt we abandoned the game due to the lack of updates,  
or may have been disappointed about the game’s future.  
But in fact, during this seemingly quiet time, our small development team has never stopped.  
We’ve been steadily pushing forward, refining every detail behind the scenes.

Along the way, we’ve been fortunate to receive much encouragement and support from players and partners.  
It’s that belief and warmth that kept us going, allowing us to build this world piece by piece.

This update represents the combined effort and dedication of our entire team.  
We hope it brings you a new experience truly worth waiting for.  
We sincerely hope you can feel our persistence and growth throughout this journey.

We’ll see you on **July 29, 2025**.

Train System Showcase Video
[previewyoutube=lRLgOtfomxc;full][/previewyoutube]

Download the full version of the video here:
https://www.patreon.com/TogetherBnB

notes.title: Game development progress #11
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/cad4639839e29f58361ccdbb6ddedc12cf345df1.png

Hello everyone,

First of all, we sincerely apologize for not being able to release the update on time! We’d like to take this opportunity to explain the reasons and share the progress with everyone.

Two-Person Interactions
Two-person interactions have always been a core system in our game. Although we previously added more interactions and features, after trying it ourselves, it honestly felt like just adding more moves. It didn’t meet our goal of providing a more unique and thrilling experience for everyone!

After continuously exploring new ideas and testing different approaches, we’ve decided tocompletely redo the current two-person interaction system! 
From interaction poses, phases of the interactions, dialogue during interactions, reactions to the surroundings, and more—we’ve redesigned everything from the ground up!

We’ve also started brand-new motion capture and voice recordings. Since the two-person interaction poses are quite difficult to capture, the post-capture adjustment process is very time-consuming. On top of that, the facial capture and recording involve tens of thousands of lines of dialogue... both the actors and our team are still hard at work on this part!

Train NPCs
In order to develop the train NPCs, we changed our character creation process and used different facial capture tools to make the characters more lively! Here are some of the girls you might encounter on the train.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/644434cca58606244679e3f9b425c83cf2daf522.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/984e3c38e1f63db353d7756402287ec0042e1a29.png

We are experimenting with a variety of different prototypes, and the system will randomly combine and vary them, so each time you encounter a different girl!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/cd7bccebc72038ac13c3f20d59ef0b8a0a78408d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/7f8f7a9ae4e4959eac0b5b8ada5dbae1625e111a.png

Because each girl is unique—some are gentle, some are lively, and they have different preferences—we’ve also designed thousands of lines of dialogue to give them more personality for you to experience!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/03ec9c771a4e36d0003ed8dc32719a72d31f7e4d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/3c1e99e21f842f7c192d7012623bfdda9d1f9207.png

We hope everyone finds a girl they like to pursue. Whether you choose to chat to increase her affection or use other methods... you’re free to decide!

Main Story and Side Quests
Our game is centered around the storyline. As the story progresses, it introduces various systems, gameplay mechanics, and even two-person interactions, all aimed at enhancing your immersion! However, the downside of this approach is that it's difficult to release updates until the story reaches a certain point.

To shorten the update cycle, we’ve been actively developing modules like the train, where we can continuously add new characters, outfits, hairstyles, and even maps that are not tied to the storyline. We hope this will speed up future updates!

For the main story and two-person interactions, we’ve also created many new scenes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/98ddd88602a406a03cfe603e2d59f80bb229084f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/fb1d30f49944708d3d8c55a96dc58a894ba7c881.png

Each scene is tightly connected to the plot, including new systems like elevators, markets for buying things, and more.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/3b75aeca5856e923c158316fdd8c95fd93dce8fe.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/87f671dede60c3e6f35a1b266066b423094eae90.png

We are putting our full effort into crafting the open world and polishing every detail.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/9ec1cde0f55055ba1a989e4a04a9c8ccaea1df00.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/1db158413da33fba2952a1ce1bc9beb27629d6d8.png

The mountain café and hidden realms are both explorable, and they each serve as great spots for two-person interactions!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/50208adb029da6cb2c7cfb61ced7852dfb9049b3.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/afae13c7fecbe2fd2539c224cb1702f54a040d3f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/3cfe8ca6d308592bec701da9cc130c63dde4ff3d.png

Meticulously designed dreamlike scenes will create unforgettable memories!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/16d74dd28310480a9c4be29242d293094255ab31.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/9d1da7939ad2470036ced2981f070371988aaedf.png

New Character
As always, with each update, we will introduce a new character, each with her own unique story!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/f889ecc15c36c8d512e4daa08bd0c77d8f993caa.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/a1d2bb8778e807a0029d7fd27b6c53b80ac89ead.png

The development of game modules is highly uncertain and time-consuming, but we’ve made considerable progress. We are now focusing on the mass production phase, which is more predictable in terms of time. With the addition of new team members, we currently estimate that this phase will be completed by the second quarter of next year.

We understand that scrapping the core system we’ve already built is a risky and painful decision, and we’re about to face even more work ahead. But... we want to do better. We want to create the best game we possibly can, for all of you who continue to speak up for us and support us no matter what. Thank you for sticking with us through thick and thin. We hope we can go even further together!

Finally, we kindly ask for a little more time. We won’t give up, and we sincerely appreciate your support!

notes.title: Game development progress #10
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/b90f2762b6319d99bb70c2293204788b83b8ac72.png
Hello everyone,

During this time, besides continuing to work on the storyline for the main characters, we have also added brand new elements to the game. Here, we would like to share our current progress with all of you.

Open World
Previously, in order to debug and improve performance, we restructured the main systems in the game. Then, we spent a lot of time in the process of upgrading to the new engine. Although it was challenging, most of the features have now been successfully migrated.

This also allows us to return to our original intention and start conceptualizing and creating the open world of Together BnB.
In order to allow everyone to fully enjoy the open world of Together BnB, we have added and are currently developing various systems.

Dating and Travel System
Now you can invite the girls to specific locations for a trip, have fun together, take photos, and listen to their stories, making the relationship between the two more intimate.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/8faa3a8a545eb36f380543f87fbe14cb1d43438e.png

AI Traffic System
We have also added various AI vehicles in the game, which have different behaviors and reactions, making your journey with the girls full of surprises and joy!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/dbde41b48564188a709cc13e6b542977552f78f6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/b236b6303c366541c93faf0046ac8dcb04b9b26b.png

If the girls ask you, you can even decide who drives and see who has better driving skills!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/a4e5fa01a14b5e1ecdb3f3a577a3241668875088.png

Photography & dating route System
When taking photos at scenic spots, you can also engage in character strategies, unlocking different photo poses. If everything goes well, the interactions between the two of you at the scenic spots will surely leave sweet memories!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/5d8dbb2490381b702026ec212444131ff72b6d13.png

Train System
We have not only expanded the size of the game map, but also added a complete train system to the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/375f8262539d6f5ae46e57e9423033036451a23d.png

You can take the train to explore around and encounter various automatically generated NPCs on the train. Each of them will have different personalities and professions. Whether they are fat, thin, old, young, or even someone else's girlfriend, you can pursue them. If there is a specific profession you would like to encounter, please let us know!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/0d4286e58e3d5de9a5de478f154a1f1fb97563de.png

Each of the four train carriages will have different NPCs. As you pass each platform, someone may board the train. However, due to their different personalities, it will depend on your skills to successfully pursue them within the given time!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/6d35d60600ea0d69188cd941eb81220bc4b1f235.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/4ddf5f2d40f85c228e11d9dbfc11d7ea08343108.png

The interaction between the two after a successful pursuit will also take place on the train, experiencing a different atmosphere!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/cd17a1c12d2c0da2d1ab88b3264207a383fd3b65.png

Interaction
We have made significant modifications to the interaction between the player and NPCs this time. Not only have we added more interactions, but the number of animations for each interaction is more than twice as many as before. There are also various new features, so please look forward to it!

Main Storyline and Side Quests
As the story progresses, we have also added new scenes and elements.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/ee5396ea1367df5d880db5b41eb59e77e3f89177.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/577f26467c84223b3eca5769d50daa7f509bce80.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/43ee9671bb9c99a6a14b712be236d2dd486044a1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/01ded58ad467ce9eb21d0b781d26159668e800c3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/199debf4e92eb399344f3af4a5a224ea3f398a4e.png

DLC&New Characters
In the next update, we will simultaneously release a DLC that includes branching main storylines, new plots, and new characters.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/de8d60c282a049240fd2081c0fcd4eb4206b743e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/9b23206d2a4c4e6fdeb4a8b44cb9e7e46d03d070.png

We have spent a long time writing scripts, creating characters, producing scenes, and rehearsing actions with motion capture actors. We have also faced the challenge of dealing with a massive amount of code. It is all thanks to the continuous support from our players that we have been able to come this far. We sincerely appreciate each and every one of you!

Next, we will continue to develop and refine the mentioned content. We will not be careless, and we will not give up. Please give us some more time, and we are planning to release the updates in the third season.

Finally, we wish everyone all the best and a happy Chinese Lunar New Year.

Game reconstruction
At present, we have reconstructed many important systems, including: NPC task and dialogue system, save system, vehicle system, weapon system, animal AI system, map system and the most important "two-person interactive behavior" system... etc.

notes.title: Game development progress #06
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/6248eaded0501befe2bc09fd02204231b9817664.png
Hi everyone,

Although we've experienced some issues, but we came through!

Recently, apart from financial issues, the most serious thing is that the motion capture unit we used to work with, decided to close down. We were devastated all of a sudden, since our work depends heavily on motion capture. Although there are other motion capture studios, but the rental price was too high for a small team like us.

However, we were not reconciled, and we refused to give up. We tried our best to find other solutions. After all our effort, we finally found a reliable partner last month. They rented their equipment to us in a reasonable way. We can continue our motion capture. 

The motion capture actors and choreographers did their best, the continuing support of sponsors from the fundraising platforms, the players' purchases and valuable comments provided... etc., in addition to our full gratitude, we are still very grateful! 

The contents we produced in the past few months are as follows:

1. Clothing
We made new clothing, and set new plots for them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/d78ef679a54206ffeb0213c50d96320dd00dc97a.png

We also tried our best to do the model details!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/318fa6747c7c687e3fb212ffdd67a0fa7f15910c.png

2. Scene
We have also created new scenes for the plot, hoping that everyone can have a brand new experience. In addition, we have added new animals to the scenes for players to hunt!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/d13ed83650199d2c6d0246862299236b03af1aad.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/ceffbb7c582519a387fc24b3593f517fadeca294.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/432b186422c325a36c2928c7fbf4b0482ca2087c.png

3. Cooking system
We have re-adjusted the cooking system. In addition to a more delicate menu and scoring mechanism, we have also re-created the character's reaction to the cooking. You can cook any dish you want, and the reaction of each character will be different!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/bd26579fee52180fd7c25da2c89793a873bbe0bf.png

Since the motion capture was not completed, we could not release the update as scheduled, we are deeply sorry! We will continue our work, and hope we can update the mainline and DLC before the end of January. Thank you for your support! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/247c2d2ef19cf4eb3567e443872935b2adeb3d74.png

notes.title: Game development progress #05
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/2e7906ee88903329d86965825caa2c414e17e165.png
Hello everyone! Here are some updates about the current development progress of the game

Updates

 First, we updated new content, including newly recorded Chinese and English voices, we also made new expression animations according to the new voices.


 We adjusted the following effects in our game, including tenants' behavior module, the speed of the text messages, the collision range, the performance of the animal AI, the focus mode of the lens...


 Optimized the sky, weather module, and environment textures.


Note
In the beginning, we designed various inter-related plots and modules, if we roll out these contents separately, it would lose the full picture and the special feature of Together BnB! But we believe that after finishing the current structure, the development speed will pick up quickly in the future.

Due to a wave of the COVID19 pandemic a while ago, our recording, motion capture, and animation production process was delayed. Currently, as the spread of the pandemic is under control, we have started the second stage of recording and related work, also the integration and debugging process are underway. Please bear with us for a while, we expect to launch a major update in December. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Game development progress #04
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/2191b05efd3e07cbf54c253618e89985c3161ff7.png
Hello everyone! Here are some updates about the current development progress of the game

1. Main storyline
The final part of the plot is more complicated, currently, our main plot is up to 90% done. 
The facial expression animations for Chinese- and English-speaking are about 75%.

2. New system
Since the main storyline of this part is related to the cooking system, after integrating the system, we still find some bugs, we are still working on it. 
We have also created a lot of menus. After trying different dishes, the NPCs will have different reactions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/94a38de88bba79e95294fd0553fc08b1e0ade424.png

3. Clothing
For this main storyline and cooking system, we also made new clothes for our NPCs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/de0a15b45cd2dbec88ebc7237c8a4466bf32cae7.png

We received and went through all of your feedback and ideas, we have been thinking about ways to improve, adjust, and optimize our game. However, the revision process takes time, and after integration with the main architecture, it requires repeated testing to discover problems. The game is still in the development stage, not mass production, so the update speed is relatively slow. 
Indeed, through early access, we are able to collect everyone’s opinion, and also obtain funding to keep the studio operating. We don’t have investors, so each of your purchases and the support from the website P are our only source of income. We are able to come so far because of everyone’s support. Although the development speed is not fast, we will take this responsibility and do our best. Thank you so much!

The progress of our main storyline is approximately 75%.

During the production process, many new technologies require developing and testing, plus the originally scheduled update contents, our development progress is still relatively slow, despite our hard work. Your encouragement and support during this period are the driving force for us to carry on, thank you again, and we'll keep going!

notes.title: Game development progress #02
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302284/85605ce7a106a0754b19a117f8ac471b033f5305.png
Hello Everyone, here's an update on the current development process.
We carry on our production in 2 directions: 

1. Main storyline
Since Nana will have more appearances than previous releases, we have already completed more than 50% of the related elements, including new scenes, costumes, props, etc. We've also decided to record a Chines dubbing, so we will have to modify all expressions and mouth movements in both Chinese and English versions. We are still working since this is a heavy workload. 

2. New system
We updated the cooking system including menus, cuisine models, and kitchenware. The NPC eating motion capture, and the programming for vegetable cutting and soup cooking systems are still under development.

We sincerely thank you for your attention and support. Although our team is relatively small and the progress is slow, we will not give up the development of Together BnB. We will carry on our work. Please rest assured, thank you everyone!

notes.title: Game development and related instructions
notes.content:
Hello everyone
Thank you for your support and advice! We will continue to collect everyone's ideas to make Together BnB more complete and enriched.
The following is the next development of the game and related instructions.

Story

 After experiencing the introduction of the characters and environment in the early stage, next will start a new story plot with each tenant as the protagonist. The story of Nana is currently being produced.

Gameplay

 With the development of the new plot, the game will extend a new system. For example, the cooking system will be added this time. The player prepares the required ingredients and cooks according to the recipe, and then invites the tenants to enjoy it. It also improves favorability when completing tasks.

The next update:

 Will add new systems, such as cooking... etc


 Rework voice-over


 Debugging and optimization will continue


Your support and expectations are our biggest gain this time. Although the development speed may not be fast, we will continue to work hard and do the best we can do. Stay tuned, thank you everyone!
